name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based MongoDB admin interface to browse databases, collections and documents, bundled with a MongoDB server.

alerts.message: The web UI asks for basic auth: sign in as admin with the generated ME_CONFIG_BASICAUTH_PASSWORD from the environment settings. Documents are evaluated as JavaScript on the server, so keep the credentials private.
MongoDB 8.0 needs a CPU with AVX support on x86_64 servers (ARMv8.2-A on arm64).
